title: queue.item.v1: one queued message of a session
description: PUBLIC record. A message a user queued for a session. delivery 'next_turn' sends it as the next turn once the current one ends; 'steer' sends it into the turn in progress where the driver can take input mid-turn, and otherwise interrupts and then sends. The item can be edited (queue.update) or withdrawn (queue.cancel) while its state is 'queued'; each edit raises revision. From 'delivering' on it cannot change. 'delivered' and 'cancelled' are final. An item is delivered at most once, across a daemon restart too.

turn_id.description: The turn the message was delivered into; null until delivery begins.
